name: RecordFlow - backup Zoom recordings to Google storage
tagline: Spent hours moving Zoom recordings into Google Drive by hand? Zoom storage filling up with recordings you don't want to lose? RecordFlow archives…
description: Spent hours moving Zoom recordings into Google Drive by hand? Zoom storage filling up with recordings you don't want to lose? RecordFlow archives every cloud recording to your Drive automatically - existing and new - then clears them out of Zoom on a safe delay, so you stop paying for storage you don't need. Connect once and never think about it again. HOW IT WORKS - Sign in with your Zoom account - no separate registration - Connect your Google Drive - personal or shared drive - Done - recordin
